title: Can't capture Embedded Game with OBS
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproductible: 4.4.rc1

### System information

Godot v4.4.rc1 - Windows 11 (build 22631) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Mobile) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3080 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6636) - 12th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i9-12900K (24 threads)

### Issue description

Hello,
I have some issues to capture the game windows with the new Embedded Game feature.

As I can see I suppose the Embedded Game windows consist in reality of 2 windows, one in Godot style with the buttons and a floating windows with the game that follow the first windows.
You can see that when mooving the windows fast enought, the game follow the windows.

But my issue is that the 2 windows have the same .exe file and the same name. The editor windows came first.

So in [OBS Studio](https://obsproject.com/) I can't select the correct windows easly because he will just select the first one he find.

If I select the correct windows I do see the game but next time the game get restarted I get back on the Embedded windows with no game.

### Steps to reproduce

- Run a game with the "Make Game Workspace Floating on Next Play" option checked
- In OBS add a game source and you will see 2 windows nammed "[godot.exe]: GameName (DEBUG)"
- Select the second one, you will see the game without the Game Workspace
- Restart the game
- See that the new captured windows is the Game Workspace instead of the game

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/ed311bf0-ac03-430b-b9cd-d3767f80ba10)

An easy fix would be to give the floating windows a different name.

The only workaround I have for now is to disable the Embed Game option. Re selecting the correct windows each time the game restart is not really a solution.

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/8717a79f-3631-40ed-8fed-f92caf5be98a)

Thanks

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

Not related to a project
